name: Beef Daube Provencal
ingredients_verbatim: 2 lbs stewing beef cut into 2 inch pieces
Salt and fresh cracked black pepper
1 bottle dry white wine (such as Chardonnay)
16 ounces canned plum tomatoes, with juices
Bouquet garni of parsley, thyme, tarragon, and bay leaves tied with kitchen string
6 carrots, peeled and sliced into batons (optional)
why: Classic Provencal chuck braise: beef simmered in white wine, tomato, mustard, garlic and herbs with carrots. Published nutrition 409 cal / 35g protein / 10g carbs per serving clears the band and is structurally low-carb (meat + wine + non-starchy veg, no rice/pasta/potato). Every main ingredient has a board home (chuck-roast, white-wine, dijon-mustard, canned tomatoes, carrots, onions, garlic). French cuisine adds variety versus the Tex-Mex-heavy catalog; not a duplicate of any existing beef braise (no daube in catalog; distinct from bourguignon which uses red wine + bacon + mushrooms). Batch-braise scalable to 14, weigh-and-divide. Cal sits at the low edge (409) so verify our computed macros land above 400.
